$comment: UI chrome that names a concept the game itself names. `terms` maps a Paraglide message key to the `fiddle/misc_local.toml` key whose text the game shows; `pnpm run i18n:sync-game-terms` copies the game's string into every messages/<locale>.json (English included) and the pipeline assets tests fail when they drift. `notes` records near-misses that stay hand-written, so the next audit does not re-derive them.

notes.quest_type_mission: misc_local/mission_quests has no translation in any locale's table (the game shows English everywhere); hand-written translations kept.
notes.relationship_status_engaged: misc_local/engaged is player-gendered in es (<he>Prometido</he><she>Prometida</she>…); the sync refuses gender markup, so the ungendered locales were copied from the game by hand and es keeps its plural.
notes.relationship_status_married: Same as relationship_status_engaged: misc_local/married carries gender markup in es.
notes.animals_color_variants_section_name: misc_local/color_variant is singular, and ru's entry is mistranslated in the game ('Выполненные задания' = completed quests); hand-written plural kept.
notes.category_quests_name: The game's journal tab is an icon; misc_local only has qualified forms (active_quests, story_quests, requests).
notes.category_mines_name: No standalone misc_local term; 'the Mines' only appears inside confirm_leave_dungeon.
notes.category_recipes_name: No misc_local term for the recipe list.
notes.category_cosmetics_name: misc_local/character_customization is the menu title; too long for the tile.
notes.merge_label_museum: Prefix form of misc_local/museum_donations with a count placeholder; interpolating the game term would need per-locale grammar.
notes.quest_type_fetch: misc_local/requests is the request-board sense; MFG's fetch category is narrower.
notes.weather_*: The game names weather in its forecast UI, not misc_local; no keys to map.
notes.rank_level_single: misc_local/renown_lvl_insert ('Lvl') is the fragment the game composes with; kept MFG's 'Lv {level}'.
